properties.name: BLR6
properties.site-address: The former Stadium Industrial Park, Springfield Avenue, Station Road, Long Eaton, Derbyshire, NG10 2DD
properties.notes: The site can support 54 units (a mixture of 2,3,4+ bedroom houses and 1 bedroom flats), as outlined in lapsed planning permission. A planning application has been received for a non-residential development scheme for this site (ERE/1018/0038) which was refused by Committee, however the Council are still supportive of residential development at this site. This site is in the SHLAA2019 Ref 333.
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
